resolved.title: 基础SQL 命令
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Basic SQL Commands[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The SQL [b]SHOW [/b]statement displays information contained in the database and its tables. This helpful tool lets you keep track of your database contents and remind yourself about the structure of your tables.
For example, the [b]SHOW DATABASES[/b] command lists the databases managed by the server.[code format="sql"]SHOW DATABASES[/code]
Throughout the tutorial we will be using the MySQL engine and the PHPMyAdmin tool to run SQL queries. 
[note]The easiest way to get MySQL and PHPMyAdmin is to install free tools like [b]XAMPP [/b]or [b]WAMP[/b], which include all necessary installers.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Basic SQL Commands[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

content.text:
SQL中**SHOW**语句将显示数据库及其表中相关的信息，可以用此命令来追踪数据库的中内容，并获得相关表结构信息。

例如，**SHOW DATABASES**命令列出当前所有的数据库：
content.text_html:
The SQL **SHOW **statement displays information contained in the database and its tables. This helpful tool lets you keep track of your database contents and remind yourself about the structure of your tables. For example, the SHOW DATABASES command lists the databases managed by the server.

SQL SHOW 语句显示数据库及其表中包含的信息。这个有用的工具可以让你跟踪你的数据库内容，并提醒你自己注意表的结构。 例如，SHOW DATABASES命令列出了服务器所管理的数据库。

content.text: 在整个课程中，我们将使用[MySQL](https://www.mysql.com/)开源数据库和[PHPMyAdmin](https://www.phpmyadmin.net/)工具来运行SQL查询。
content.text_html:
Throughout the tutorial we will be using the MySQL engine and the PHPMyAdmin tool to run SQL queries.

在整个教程中，我们将使用MySQL引擎和PHPMyAdmin工具来运行SQL查询。

content.text: 安装MySQL和PHPMyAdmin的最简单方法是使用如[XAMPP](https://baike.baidu.com/item/XAMPP/2801774?fr=aladdin)或[WAMP](https://baike.baidu.com/item/WAMP/7296769?fr=aladdin)的工具，其中包括所有必要的安装程序。
content.text_html:
The easiest way to get MySQL and PHPMyAdmin is to install free tools like **XAMPP **or WAMP, which include all necessary installers.

获得MySQL和PHPMyAdmin的最简单方法是安装免费工具，如XAMPP 或WAMP，其中包括所有必要的安装程序。

resolved.title: 基础SQL 命令
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Basic SQL Commands[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]SHOW COLUMNS[/b] displays information about the columns in a given table.

The following example displays the columns in our [b]customers [/b]table:[code format="sql"][b]SHOW COLUMNS FROM[/b] customers[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2791" width="100%"]
SHOW COLUMNS displays the following values for each table column: 

[b]Field[/b]: column name
[b]Type[/b]: column data type
[b]Key[/b]: indicates whether the column is indexed
[b]Default[/b]: default value assigned to the column
[b]Extra[/b]: may contain any additional information that is available about a given column
[note]The columns for the [b]customers [/b]table have also been created using the PHPMyAdmin tool.[/note]

content.text:
**SHOW COLUMNS**显示的信息主要如下：

**Key**：该列是否存在索引
**Default**：该列的默认值
**Extra**：关于特定列的额外信息

resolved.title: SELECT 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]SELECT Statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]SELECT [/b]statement is used to select data from a database.
The result is stored in a result table, which is called the [b]result-set[/b].

A [b]query [/b]may retrieve information from selected columns or from all columns in the table. 
To create a simple SELECT statement, specify the name(s) of the column(s) you need from the table.

[s0l0!-header][b]Syntax of the SQL SELECT Statement:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ][b]SELECT[/b] column_list
[b]FROM[/b] table_name[/code]
- [b]column_list[/b] includes one or more columns from which data is retrieved
- [b]table-name[/b] is the name of the table from which the information is retrieved

[s0l0!-header][b]Below is the data from our customers table:[/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2792" width="100%"]
The following SQL statement selects the [b]FirstName [/b]from the [b]customers [/b]table:[code format="sql" codeId="3030"]SELECT FirstName FROM customers[/code]
[img id="2793" width="100%"]
[note]A SELECT statement retrieves zero or more rows from one or more database tables.[/note]
